premises.text: Manufacturing downtime and inefficiencies remain a massive cost despite robots and automation
premises.evidence_span: downtime is still costing industrial players over 11% of their yearly turnover

premises.text: Nearshoring and new production demand require factories in markets like Mexico to become intelligent quickly
premises.evidence_span: Nearshoring is becoming the strategic pivot, moving manufacturing closer to its consumer

premises.text: A CapEx-lite gateway connecting most industrial protocols pulls machine, process, and health data as the factory source of truth
premises.evidence_span: built-in code that supports the most widely used connectivity protocols, allowing us to connect to over 90% of industrial machinery categories

premises.text: ML models detect failures and recommend probable causes and actions rather than only monitoring
premises.evidence_span: We tell factories what's the probable cause and what's the recommended course of action

premises.text: An efficiency module tracks productivity, quality, costs, and availability with actionable waste and density alerts
premises.evidence_span: In our efficiency module, we're tracking productivity, quality, costs, and availability

premises.text: A generative BI chatbot trained on plant data answers operational questions and visualizes insights in seconds
premises.evidence_span: this assistant is trained with all of your productivity data

premises.text: Every customer action improves shared algorithms, creating cross-customer network effects
premises.evidence_span: every single action improves our model's algorithms, creating network effects that ultimately benefit every single customer on our platform
